subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, conflicting onboarding PR be closed as superseded by current macOS onboarding work, or should the contributor rebase it into a narrow follow-up?
rationale: Current main already implements much of the local Gateway and onboarding direction, but the protected label and remaining UX/security choices require explicit maintainer intent before cleanup close or adoption.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 are the intended path and any remaining gaps should be filed narrowly.

options.title: Request Narrow Rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, remove stale wizard-era changes, fix the security/auth findings, and add live macOS proof.

options.title: Adopt Selected Ideas Manually
options.body: Have a maintainer extract only the still-useful copy or tests into the current onboarding architecture without treating this branch as the landing vehicle.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 are the intended path and any remaining gaps should be filed narrowly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged macOS onboarding and Gateway setup commits make this the clearest current product-direction owner.
